note: Live `npx pr-shepherd iterate 522 --verbose --format=json` apiUsage, two one-shot ticks per transport from a fresh PR_SHEPHERD_STATE_DIR. A one-shot iterate never uses the fingerprint cache (only the poll path passes fingerprintCache), so every tick is a full read and these ticks do not measure the fingerprint hit or miss costs. bench.mjs compares these measurements with its per-tick model. Made read-only by a temporary untracked .pr-shepherdrc.yml (iterate.minimizeComments: none, actions.autoMinimizeSuppressed: false, actions.autoMarkReady: false) and a PR with no unresolved outdated threads; GraphQL unmeasuredRequestCount was 0 (no mutations) and the debug log shows only GET requests, all 200 (no conditional 304s). Run outside Claude Code cloud (CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE unset), so the REST ticks are the explicit `--transport rest` path without the per-PR `/ccr/review_threads` read; the bench adds that read for its cloud REST arm. The REST one-PR tick was modeled at 12 requests before this check. CI had no failing check, so job and log triage reads were not exercised. The REST ticks were re-measured the same way on jonathanong/pr-shepherd#548 at db6a628, after REST reads became conditional; the #522 REST ticks (17 and 14 requests, all 200) predate that. A live If-None-Match probe of #548's own CI (pull, check runs, check suites, combined status, statuses, reviews, issue and review comments, base branch, workflow runs; 8 rounds about 34s apart) answered 304 for every unchanged resource, and while CI ran at most three check reads (check runs, check suites, workflow runs) changed per round.
